outcome: Hypercare lets the PM log a metric observation with proof and set the criteria
acceptance_criteria: No release form: on every fixture (F-115's `4202` to `4204` and this feature's) there is no "Record release" button, no release proof select, and no POST to `stability/events` or `release-register` — verify: e2e asserts absence and request capture; grep `stability/events`, `release-register`, `observe_release`, `can_record_release` in the new non-test files returns nothing.

F-115's release and acceptance facts section is unchanged by this feature — verify: F-115's tests still pass; the diff to `hypercareAdapter.ts` is only the `Actions` assignment and the new descriptors.
On `4301`, choosing Engineering shows only the `error_rate` row; choosing Infrastructure shows only `uptime`; a different owner's metric is never drawn — verify: page.

Observation validation: an empty metric row without "Not known" blocks the button; "Not known" sends `null`; `0` typed is sent as `0`; nothing defaults to 0; `confirmed` has no preselected radio and "Not known" sends `null`; the button stays off with no proof selected — verify: unit test on `hypercareForms.ts`.

The observation POST body is exactly `{expected_revision, case_revision, configuration_id, owner, observed_at, confirmed, reference, evidence_id, metrics}`: no `verify_sample`, no note, no key not in the contract, and `metrics` has exactly that owner's approved keys — verify: request capture; unit test.
After an observation 201 the page re-reads and F-115's criteria list shows the new result; the success text appears only when `observations[]` changed — verify: e2e on `4305`.
`4302` offers only Infrastructure; `4303` (no proofs) disables the button with "No proof is on this project yet."; `4304` and `4305` draw no observation form — verify: pages.
A 409 `STALE_VERSION` on the observation re-reads, keeps owner, time, reference and proof, clears the metric values, and shows the server message — verify: scenario test.

On `4306` the criteria form draws the controls above with nothing prefilled; invalid key text, a duplicate key for the same owner, 0 confirmation owners, hours above 87600 and a missing policy decision each show their message and keep the button off — verify: unit test and page.

Submitting criteria sends exactly one `POST /api/v1/work/4306/stability/criteria` with `{case_revision, criteria, evidence_id, effective_from}`, `criteria.clock` `elapsed_hours_since_release`, `criteria.financial_controls` `independent`, no `issue_clearance`, no `expected_revision`; `evidence_id` is a `policy_decision` proof — verify: request capture.

After the draft 201 the page says the draft needs review, reads the policy configurations (following `next_page`, max 4 pages) and shows the "Mark as validated" button only because the item lists `validated`; `4307` shows "Waiting for a reviewer" and no button; `4308` shows the missing policy decision text — verify: pages.

Review sends `POST /api/v1/setup/{case_id}/policy-configurations/90/review` with `{case_revision (from the policy read), state_id, transition}`; "Make these the hypercare criteria" opens the confirm dialog first; `revoked` is never offered — verify: request capture; grep `revoked` in the new files finds no button.

The "criteria are now active" text appears only when the re-read `stability` shows the new `criteria` and `configuration_id`; with a stale re-read the page says it could not confirm — verify: e2e with a delayed mock.

Error mapping for the observation, criteria and review POSTs: 409, 403 `csrf_failed` (one session refresh, "Press the button again", one POST), 403, 404, 422 with `fields`, 429, 503, network; after each failure no automatic resend; entered values stay — verify: unit tests counting fetch calls per scenario (`4309`).

Uncertain effect: after a dropped connection the page re-reads; `4310` (record present) shows it as recorded, `4311` (absent) locks the form with the "couldn't confirm" text and unlocks only after the item `revision` changes or a reload — verify: e2e.
Press lock: a double click on any form's button sends one request; while one form works, the other forms' buttons are disabled — verify: e2e request count.
A `null` `expected_revision` (`4312`) or `case_revision` (`4313`) holds the form with the "current version" sentence and sends nothing — verify: unit test.

Nothing sends on page load, polling or navigation: the only POSTs are the observation, criteria and review calls, from a press — verify: e2e asserts zero POSTs on load; `grep -rn "\.POST(\|liveApi.POST" frontend/src/features/hypercare` shows only F-115's background call and call sites inside the four builders.

Hidden parts: no "Log an issue", no `verify_sample` control, no free-note field on the observation form, no go-live acceptance action, no file upload control, no release form or release-register call — verify: grep for `release-register`, `acceptance`, `verify_sample`, `fileToEvidence` in `frontend/src/features/hypercare` returns nothing outside tests.

Wrong user: a viewer whose reads return `observation_owners:[]`, `can_draft_criteria:false` and no review `actions` sees none of the forms and sends no request; a direct server 403 on a crafted POST shows "You can't do this." — verify: mock accounts; scenario.

Wrong tenant: a work id the account cannot see (404 from every read) shows "This record is unavailable." and no form — verify: open an unknown id in the mock; compare with F-115's wording; against live Django use a work id from another organisation.

Viewport 1440 and 390: forms are one column on the phone, controls 44 px high, no horizontal scroll, no axe violations; the forms use the existing design-system tokens and components — verify: screenshots; `hypercare-record.spec.ts` axe run.

No file under `frontend/src/features/workspace` or `frontend/src/features/work-item` is changed, and `HypercareActions` is registered only through the `Actions` field of F-115's adapter — verify: `git diff --stat origin/main -- frontend/src/features/workspace frontend/src/features/work-item` is empty; a test renders the adapter's `Actions` with the right props.

Against live Django (8030, the lane-d Postgres fixture, a PM account that is an observation owner on a `delivery-hypercare/v1` item): record one observation, and the `curl` of `/api/v1/work/{id}/stability` shows the new `observations[]` row and an updated `criterion_results[]`; a repeated call with a stale `expected_revision` returns 409 and the page shows the stale text — verify: curl against the same work id; page.
`npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm test` pass and `api-live-schema-drift.test.ts` passes — verify: `delivery/checks.sh`.

risk.rationale: High. Observations and the release record feed the qualified result and the acceptance and closure gates, and a recorded release cannot be quietly undone (`stability/events` 201, `release-register` `observe_release`). Evidence upload (D-1) and the policy-configuration review (criteria) touch records that other decisions depend on, so the surfaces are ui and api, with the review step needing a deliberate authority check. No money or payroll is involved. Sources: `screens-d-delivery-issues-escalation.md` SCR-46, backend answers D-1, D-18 and D-19, the 1.25.0 contract paths `stability`, `stability/events`, `stability/criteria` and `release-register`, and F-115's spec as the binding part-1 boundary.
